marketing.whatSubtitle: Turn a spec URL into a live workspace: browse operations, generate code, and exercise endpoints without juggling five tools.
marketing.card1Body: Load OpenAPI 3 and Swagger 2 from URLs and Swagger UI pages.
marketing.card2Body: TypeScript shapes, IDE-ready prompts, and structured test ideas scoped to the endpoint or collection.
marketing.card3Body: Compose requests from the spec, describe payloads in plain language, and validate responses against schemas.
marketing.showcaseTitle: Everything you need. Right where you need it.
marketing.showcaseSubtitle: A single surface for exploration, generation, and execution — tuned for deep work.
marketing.showcaseBullets: No more manual parsing|Collections and filters that stay fast on large specs|AI payload and schema insight beside your editor|Re-parse a new URL from the header without losing flow
marketing.stepsSubtitle: From URL to validated request in four moves.
marketing.step1Body: Point APIForge at your OpenAPI or Swagger source.
marketing.step2Body: Scan tags, methods, and paths with search and filters.
marketing.step3Body: Stream TypeScript and prompts aligned to the active operation.
marketing.step4Body: Send requests, tune bodies, and check responses against the spec.
marketing.playSubtitle: Same parser as the hero — jump in when you are ready to load a real spec.
marketing.whySubtitle: Built for specs that power real products — not toy demos.
marketing.why1Body: Runs in the browser. Paste a URL and start — no CLI install or account wall.
marketing.why2Body: Optimized path for common Swagger UI and hosted JSON patterns.
marketing.why3Body: Monospace affordances, keyboard-friendly controls, and dense information layout.
marketing.why4Body: Groq-backed generation with clear streaming and copy-ready outputs.

landing.subtitle: Transform static documentation into interactive explorers. High-precision parsing for the modern developer ecosystem.

hero.subtitle: Paste an OpenAPI or Swagger URL. Browse operations, then generate TypeScript types, IDE prompts, and test cases with Groq.
hero.card1Body: Resolves many Swagger UI pages and embedded specs, plus raw JSON and YAML.
hero.card2Body: LLM-generated docs and types from each operation’s parameters and schemas.
hero.card3Body: Copy or download TypeScript, IDE prompts, and generated test cases.

runApi.title: API execution
runApi.testsEmpty: No tests yet. Add tests to validate the response.
runApi.noSpecAuth: The spec declares no security for this operation.
runApi.workspaceBearerHint: Sent as a Bearer token on every request that has no other auth and no Authorization header.

runApi.corsBlockedSub: The target API does not expose CORS headers for browser-origin requests. APIForge can execute this request securely through its server-side execution gateway.
runApi.securityBlockedTitle: Request blocked by the network safety policy
runApi.baseUrlMissing: Add a server URL to send requests. The spec did not declare one.
runApi.noParams: This operation declares no parameters. Add query parameters if you need them.
runApi.headersHint: Checked rows are sent. Auth headers come from the Auth tab unless you set Authorization here.
runApi.bodyFromExample: Filled from the example in the spec.
runApi.bodyFromSchema: Generated from the schema, required fields first. Replace the placeholder values.

runApi.schemaFailed: The schema check could not run. Use the retry button above.

support.sectionSubtitle: APIForge currently operates entirely on community free-tier models. While great for basic workflows, free models face strict rate limits and reduced reasoning depth. Your funding directly sponsors paid flagship models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, DeepSeek R1 Pro) to supercharge result accuracy and unlock powerful new features for the entire community.
support.card1Body: Currently, we rely on free models that can occasionally hallucinate or truncate complex schemas. Your support funds paid Claude 3.5 Sonnet & GPT-4o keys for unmatched reasoning precision across massive APIs.
support.card2Body: Paid models will unlock new capabilities: comprehensive edge-case mock generation, automated schema breaking-change analysis, and multi-file contract refactoring.
support.card3Body: All core developer tools—the interactive OpenAPI explorer, live request runner, and schema validation—will remain completely free, public, and open-source forever.
